title: Integration — Wire UserEditDialog into Users Page
content:
Integrate the UserEditDialog into the admin users page. Adds row-click handler to open the edit dialog, and handles save/refresh cycle.

## Changes to users/page.tsx
1. Add row click handler — clicking a user row opens UserEditDialog
2. Add UserEditDialog component import and state management
3. On successful save: close dialog, refresh user list, show toast
4. On error: show toast, keep dialog open

## Key integration points:
- Use AdminDataTable's row click capability (or add an action column with edit button)
- Manage dialog open/close state and selected user ID
- After successful PATCH, refetch the users list to reflect changes
- Coordinate with shared components from AD-007 (AdminPageHeader, AdminPagination, AdminDataTable)

No new components — only wiring existing pieces together.
acceptance: Clicking a user row opens UserEditDialog with prefilled data
Dialog displays correct user data fetched from GET /api/admin/users/[id]
Successful save closes dialog and refreshes the users list
Failed save shows error toast, dialog stays open
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/[locale]/admin/users/page.tsx (refactor — add row click handler, edit dialog integration)
dependencies: AD-007-3 refactors users/page.tsx to use AdminDataTable, AdminPageHeader, AdminPagination. AD-008-2 provides UserEditDialog component.
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && visit /en/admin/users → click user row → edit dialog opens → modify fields → save → toast confirms → list refreshes.
